newsitem.title: UK: North Sea Schooner gas field starts production.
newsitem.headline: North Sea Schooner gas field starts production.

text.p: The Schooner natural gas field in the U.K. sector of the southern North Sea began production on Monday, operator Shell UK Exploration and Production (Shell Expro) said.
Shell Expro, a joint venture between Royal Dutch/Shell Group and Exxon Corp, said Schooner will produce an initial 130 million standard cubic feet a day (MMscf/d), peaking at 170 MMscf/d.
The field has estimated gas reserves of 600 billion standard cubic feet. Schooner gas is transported through a new 406-millimetre diameter pipeline to the Murdoch platform.
It will then be taken ashore via the Caistor Murdoch system to the gas processing plant at Theddlethorpe.
The 262 million stg Schooner field is operated by Shell Expro. Sovereign Exploration Ltd and Eastern Natural Gas (Offshore) Ltd also have stakes in the field. --London newsroom, +44 171 542 6280
